cover_headline: Cosmoserve Raises $6 Million to Remove Space Debris, Opens Hyderabad Facility
facts: The $6 million seed round led by Japan's Rebright Partners takes Cosmoserve's total funding past $9 million since it was founded last year
Base 1 in Hyderabad has a rendezvous and capture lab, an ISO Class 8 clean room and a microgravity simulation platform
Founder Chiranjeevi Phanindra, who spent close to 15 years at ISRO, targets completing all technology demonstrations by 2027 and starting commercial operations by 2028

end.headline: Cosmoserve Raises $6 Million to Remove Space Debris, Opens Hyderabad Facility
end.line: The ex-ISRO founder's startup pairs a Rebright-led seed round with Base 1, a debris-removal test facility, and a retest of its failed first capture mission.
